params.language: string - filter by language (UI: 14 locales; skill metadata is English-primary)

search.returns: Array of skills with all fields including translations

bulk_download.note: Returns ALL 67,759 skills in one request. ~94MB uncompressed (~8MB gzipped transfer). Prefer /api/skills-lite.json or the paginated /api/skills endpoint. Cache locally for 24h.

categories.returns: Array of {name, slug, count} for all 16 categories

manifest.returns: Marketplace metadata, pricing tiers, commission rates

skill_detail.returns: Single skill with translations, system_prompt, install command

purchase.note: Redirect user to the URL. After payment, Stripe redirects back to /vault?success=true

verify_purchase.note: Use this to verify a purchase was completed (for agents that handle payments programmatically)

multi_language.description: The site UI and docs are available in 13 languages. Skill metadata is English-primary; the legacy translations field is not populated in the current catalog.

capability_search.description: Search by what the skill CAN DO, not just keywords. Use the AI Skill Matcher at /registry.
capability_search.api: POST /api/ai-match (coming soon) — for now, use /api/skills.json and filter client-side

price_filtering.description: All 67,759 indexed skills are open-source MCP servers — price $0, free to install.
price_filtering.note: Price filters exist for future premium listings; today every indexed entry is $0.

bulk_operations.description: Download the entire catalog once, cache locally, and filter/search client-side. Refresh every 24h.

webhook_notifications.description: Coming soon: register a webhook URL to receive notifications when new skills are added in your categories of interest.

find_cheapest_skill.description: Find the cheapest skill for a task

find_multilingual_skill.description: Find a skill that supports Chinese

buy_and_install.code:
1. POST /api/create-checkout-session {skillId: 'mn-gen-00015'}
2. Redirect user to response.url
3. After payment, user returns to /vault?success=true
4. Skill is saved in localStorage
5. Run: npx -y @marketnow/install <slug>

recommend_for_user.description: Recommend skills based on user's language and needs
